title: Hedgehog with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- hedgehog body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="34" ry="24" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="22" ry="17" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="38" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#C49A6C"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="38" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#C49A6C"/>
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="38" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="38" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
  <!-- face snout area -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="57" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#4A2C17"/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="48" r="5.5" fill="#1E1B4B"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="48" r="5.5" fill="#1E1B4B"/>
  <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx="38.5" cy="46" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58.5" cy="46" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- extra sparkle highlights -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="49.5" r="0.8" fill="#FFFACD"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="49.5" r="0.8" fill="#FFFACD"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M46 63 Q50 66 54 63" stroke="#4A2C17" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- quills/spikes on back -->
  <g fill="#6B4226" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="1.5">
    <polygon points="22,55 18,40 26,48"/>
    <polygon points="30,45 28,30 34,40"/>
    <polygon points="40,40 40,25 44,37"/>
    <polygon points="52,38 54,23 56,38"/>
    <polygon points="62,40 68,27 68,40"/>
    <polygon points="72,45 78,33 76,47"/>
    <polygon points="80,54 88,42 84,55"/>
    <polygon points="26,65 16,56 26,58"/>
    <polygon points="78,63 88,54 82,64"/>
  </g>
  <!-- quill highlights -->
  <g fill="#A0704A">
    <polygon points="24,52 20,42 27,48"/>
    <polygon points="32,43 30,33 35,41"/>
    <polygon points="42,38 42,28 45,37"/>
    <polygon points="54,37 55,26 57,37"/>
    <polygon points="64,39 68,30 68,40"/>
    <polygon points="74,44 78,35 77,46"/>
    <polygon points="80,52 85,44 83,54"/>
  </g>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="90" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="90" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- tiny toes -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="92" r="1.5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="93" r="1.5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="92" r="1.5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="92" r="1.5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="93" r="1.5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="92" r="1.5" fill="#D2A679"/>
</svg>
